rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst and notes possible mismatch between image and reported 3AA, but it overstates confidence in ICM location/quality and TE cohesiveness from a limited focal plane; image appears somewhat less clearly expanded/crisp than described.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, male factor, partner age, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though interaction of semen parameters with prognosis is somewhat speculative without more male-factor details.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a sensible link from morphology plus age-related aneuploidy risk to prognosis; minor inconsistency in discussing stage 3 versus expanded terminology but overall logic is sound.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good day-5 blastocyst, attention to luteal support, cautious discussion of PGT-A, and no routine bed rest. Minor grading terminology imprecision prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, and future evaluation of embryology/male factor. Useful but not highly specific on protocol-level decisions.
